ei.title: The growing divergence of American communities is important...
ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: The growing divergence of American communities is important not just in itself but because of what it means for American society. While the divide is first and foremost economic, it is now beginning to affect cultural identity, health, family stability, and even politics. The sorting of highly educated Americans into some communities and less educated Americans into others tends to magnify and intensify all other socioeconomic differences. For example, there are vast differences in life expectancy among inhabitants of American cities, and these differences have been expanding for the past three decades. Rather than isolating differences, successful societies create space for them to coexist and enrich the broader community. The divorce rates, crime rates, and political clout of different communities have also been diverging. These trends are reshaping the very fabric of our society.

questions.passage: The (A)[growing / shrinking] divergence of American communities is important not just in itself but because of what it means for American society. While the divide is first and foremost (B)[recreational / economic], it is now beginning to affect cultural identity, health, family stability, and even politics. The sorting of highly educated Americans into some communities and less educated Americans into others tends to (C)[minimize / magnify] and intensify all other socioeconomic differences. For example, there are vast differences in life expectancy among inhabitants of American cities, and these differences have been expanding for the past three decades. Rather than isolating differences, successful societies create space for them to coexist and enrich the broader community. The divorce rates, crime rates, and political clout of different communities have also been diverging. These trends are reshaping the very fabric of our society.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 미국 지역사회의 '커지는(growing)' 분화. 분열은 무엇보다 '경제적(economic)'. 다른 차이를 '증대시키는(magnify)' 경향.
det.analysis:
❌ ① minimize(최소화하다)는 원문 magnify(증대시키다)의 반의어
❌ ② shrinking(줄어드는)은 원문 growing(커지는)의 반의어
✅ ③ growing — economic — magnify: 원문 일치
❌ ④ recreational(오락적인)은 원문 economic(경제적인)과 맥락 불일치

questions.passage: The growing divergence of American communities is important not just in itself but because of what it means for American society. While the divide is first and foremost economic, it is now beginning to affect cultural identity, health, family stability, and even politics. The sorting of highly educated Americans into some communities and less educated Americans into others tends to magnify and intensify all other socioeconomic differences. For example, there are vast differences in life expectancy among inhabitants of American cities, and these differences have been (A)[contracting / expanding] for the past three decades. Rather than isolating differences, (B)[failing / successful] societies create space for them to coexist and enrich the broader community. The divorce rates, crime rates, and political clout of different communities have also been diverging. These trends are (C)[reshaping / preserving] the very fabric of our society.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 차이가 지난 30년간 '확대되어(expanding)' 왔다. '성공적인(successful)' 사회는 차이가 공존할 공간을 만든다. 이 추세가 사회 구조를 '재편하고(reshaping)' 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① expanding — successful — reshaping: 원문 일치
❌ ② contracting(수축하는)은 원문 expanding(확대하는)의 반의어
❌ ③ failing(실패하는)은 원문 successful(성공적인)의 반의어
❌ ④ preserving(보존하는)은 원문 reshaping(재편하는)의 반의어

questions.passage: The growing divergence of American communities is important not just in itself but because of what it means for American society. While the divide is first and foremost economic, it is now beginning to affect cultural identity, health, family stability, and even politics. The sorting of highly educated Americans into some communities and less educated Americans into others tends to magnify and intensify all other socioeconomic differences. For example, there are vast differences in life expectancy among inhabitants of American cities, and these differences have been expanding for the past three decades. Rather than (A)[isolating / embracing] differences, successful societies create space for them to coexist and (B)[enrich / diminish] the broader community. The divorce rates, crime rates, and political clout of different communities have also been diverging. These trends are reshaping the very (C)[surface / fabric] of our society.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 차이를 '고립시키기(isolating)' 보다는. 더 넓은 지역사회를 '풍요롭게(enrich)' 한다. 우리 사회의 바로 그 '조직(fabric)'을 재편하고 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① embracing(포용하는)은 원문 isolating(고립시키는)과 의미 불일치 (Rather than isolating 구문)
❌ ② diminish(줄이다)는 원문 enrich(풍요롭게 하다)의 반의어
❌ ③ surface(표면)은 원문 fabric(조직, 구조)와 의미 불일치
✅ ④ isolating — enrich — fabric: 원문 일치

questions.passage: The growing ①<u>divergence</u> of American communities is important not just in itself but because of what it means for American society. While the divide is first and foremost ②<u>ecological</u>, it is now beginning to affect cultural identity, health, family stability, and even politics. The sorting of highly educated Americans into some communities and less educated Americans into others tends to magnify and intensify all other socioeconomic differences. For example, there are vast differences in life expectancy among ③<u>inhabitants</u> of American cities, and these differences have been expanding for the past three decades. Rather than isolating differences, successful societies create space for them to coexist and enrich the broader community. The divorce rates, crime rates, and political clout of different communities have also been ④<u>diverging</u>. These trends are reshaping the very fabric of our society.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 economic(경제적인)인데 ecological(생태적인)로 바꿈. 분열이 무엇보다 '경제적'이라는 맥락.
det.analysis:
✅ ① divergence(분화): 미국 지역사회의 커지는 분화라는 주제에 적절
❌ ② ecological(생태적인) → economic(경제적인): 분열이 무엇보다 '경제적'이라는 문맥. ecological(생태적)은 환경 관련 용어로 사회 분열 맥락과 불일치
✅ ③ inhabitants(주민): 미국 도시 주민들 사이의 기대수명 차이라는 서술에 적절
✅ ④ diverging(분화하는): 이혼율, 범죄율 등이 분화하고 있다는 서술에 적절

questions.passage: The growing divergence of American communities is important not just in itself but because of what it means for American society. The sorting of highly ①<u>educated</u> Americans into some communities and less educated Americans into others tends to magnify and intensify all other socioeconomic differences. For example, there are ②<u>trivial</u> differences in life expectancy among inhabitants of American cities, and these differences have been ③<u>expanding</u> for the past three decades. Rather than isolating differences, successful societies create space for them to coexist and enrich the ④<u>broader</u> community. The divorce rates, crime rates, and political clout of different communities have also been diverging. These trends are reshaping the very fabric of our society.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 vast(광대한)인데 trivial(사소한)로 바꿈. 미국 도시 주민들 사이에 기대수명의 '엄청난' 차이가 있다는 맥락.
det.analysis:
✅ ① educated(교육받은): 고학력 미국인이 특정 지역사회로 분류된다는 서술에 적절
❌ ② trivial(사소한) → vast(광대한): 도시 주민들 사이 기대수명 차이가 '엄청나다'는 문맥. trivial은 차이가 사소하다는 뜻으로 정반대
✅ ③ expanding(확대되는): 차이가 지난 30년간 확대되어 왔다는 설명에 적절
✅ ④ broader(더 넓은): 더 넓은 지역사회를 풍요롭게 한다는 서술에 적절

questions.passage: The growing divergence of American communities is important not just in itself but because of what it means for American society. For example, there are vast differences in life expectancy among inhabitants of American cities, and these differences have been expanding for the past three ③<u>decades</u>. Rather than isolating differences, successful societies create space for them to coexist and enrich the broader community. The divorce rates, crime rates, and political ④<u>harmony</u> of different communities have also been diverging. These trends are reshaping the very fabric of our society.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 clout(영향력)인데 harmony(조화)로 바꿈. 정치적 '영향력'이 분화되고 있다는 맥락에서 '조화'는 분화(diverging)와 모순.
det.analysis:
✅ ① identity(정체성): 문화적 정체성에 영향을 미친다는 서술에 적절
✅ ② intensify(강화하다): 사회경제적 차이를 증대·강화한다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ③ decades(수십 년): 지난 30년간이라는 시간 표현에 적절
❌ ④ harmony(조화) → clout(영향력): 이혼율, 범죄율, 정치적 '영향력'이 분화되는 문맥. harmony(조화)는 diverging(분화)과 의미 충돌

questions.passage:
(A) The teacher asked the students to <u>divide</u> the pizza equally among themselves.

(B) While the <u>divide</u> is first and foremost economic, it is now beginning to affect many aspects of life.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 divide의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A)에서 divide는 '나누다'(동사, 물리적 분배), (B)에서는 '격차'(명사, 사회적 분열).
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 격차 — (B) 나누다: (A)와 (B)의 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ② (A) 분열 — (B) 분리하다: (A)는 피자를 '나누는' 물리적 행위이지 분열이 아님
✅ ③ (A) 나누다 — (B) 격차: (A) divide the pizza = 피자를 나누다, (B) the divide = 격차/분열
❌ ④ (A) 나누다 — (B) 분리하다: (B)는 동사가 아닌 명사 the divide(격차)임
det.tip: divide: 동사 '나누다' / 명사 '격차, 분열'. 품사로 구분

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the power or influence that a person or group has, especially in politics or business"

det.korean: clout = 영향력 (특히 정치나 사업에서의 권력/영향력).
det.analysis:
❌ ① stability(안정성): 변하지 않는 상태로 권력/영향력과 다름
✅ ② clout(영향력): 정치·사업에서의 권력/영향력이라는 정의에 정확히 부합
❌ ③ fabric(구조, 조직): 사회의 구조를 의미하며 권력과 다름
❌ ④ identity(정체성): 자아/집단의 특성으로 권력과 다름

questions.passage: While the divide is first and foremost economic, it is now __________ (begin) to affect cultural identity, health, family stability, and even politics.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

begin → ____

det.korean: 분열이 이제 문화적 정체성, 건강 등에 영향을 미치기 '시작하고 있다'는 문맥. is + ___ing 현재진행형.
det.analysis: begin → beginning. is now __________ to affect 구조에서 be + -ing 현재진행형 필요. is now beginning to affect = '이제 영향을 미치기 시작하고 있다'.
det.tip: be + -ing = 진행형. begin → beginning (n 중복 주의)

questions.passage: The sorting of highly __________ (education) Americans into some communities and less __________ (education) Americans into others tends to magnify and intensify all other socioeconomic differences.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

education → ____

det.korean: 고학력 미국인과 저학력 미국인의 분류라는 문맥. highly + ___ + Americans에서 과거분사 형용사.
det.analysis: education → educated. 명사 education을 형용사(과거분사)로 변환. highly educated Americans = '고학력 미국인'. 분사가 명사 Americans를 수식.

questions.passage: The growing divergence of American communities is important not just in itself but because of what it means for American society. While the divide is first and foremost economic, it is now beginning to affect __________, health, family stability, and even politics. The sorting of highly educated Americans into some communities and less educated Americans into others tends to magnify and intensify all other socioeconomic differences. For example, there are vast differences in life expectancy among inhabitants of American cities, and these differences have been expanding for the past three decades. Rather than isolating differences, successful societies create space for them to coexist and enrich the broader community. The divorce rates, crime rates, and political clout of different communities have also been diverging. These trends are reshaping the very fabric of our society.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 문화적 정체성(cultural identity). 분열이 건강, 가족 안정성, 정치뿐 아니라 '문화적 정체성'에도 영향을 미치기 시작했다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① cultural identity(문화적 정체성): it is now beginning to affect cultural identity, health... 원문 표현
❌ ② personal wealth(개인 재산): 언급되지 않음. 경제적 분열은 전제이지 영향 대상 목록에 포함되지 않음
❌ ③ foreign policy(외교 정책): 국내 지역사회 분화 주제와 무관
❌ ④ natural resources(천연자원): 언급되지 않음

det.korean: 우리 사회의 바로 그 조직(the very fabric of our society). 이러한 추세가 사회의 근본 구조를 재편하고 있다는 결론.
det.analysis:
❌ ① the economic future of our nation(우리 나라의 경제적 미래): 경제는 분열의 한 측면이지 재편 대상 전체가 아님
❌ ② the political landscape of America(미국의 정치 지형): 정치는 나열된 여러 영역 중 하나일 뿐
❌ ③ the educational system of our time(우리 시대의 교육 제도): 교육은 분류 기준이지 재편 대상 표현이 아님
✅ ④ the very fabric of our society(우리 사회의 바로 그 조직): 원문 표현. 사회의 근본 구조가 재편되고 있다는 포괄적 결론
det.tip: the very fabric of our society = 우리 사회의 근본 조직/구조
